C:P1.1.text: Federated Hermes | Meeting the diverse and evolving needs of global investors

C:P1.2.text: Meeting the diverse and evolving needs of global investors

C:P1.3.text: Federated Hermes is committed to doing business the right way by providing active investors a broad spectrum of investment solutions.

C:P1.4.text: Explore critical thinking on markets and companies from our investment professionals.

C:P1.5.text: Current views and positioning of our Fixed Income committees.

C:P1.6.text: With 50 years of experience, we ruthlessly vet investments and aim to provide sound liquidity management through all market environments.

C:P1.7.text: Federated Hermes is a leading global, active asset manager, focused on meeting the diverse and evolving needs of today’s investors.

C:P1.8.text: As an active investment manager investing around the world, Federated Hermes’ believes the best investment ideas come from focused teams with differentiated perspectives and strong risk controls and oversight. Our investment solutions span a range of risk and return profiles, allowing us to target investors’ specific financial needs.

C:P1.9.text: Independent teams seek competitive long-term returns in actively managed growth, value and blend strategies, as well as across capitalizations and regions.

C:P1.10.text: Active fixed-income strategies across the spectrum (yield curve, quality and regions) designed for total return, income generation and capital preservation.

C:P1.11.text: A pioneer in liquidity management, offering one of the largest menus of targeted solutions.

C:P1.12.text: Offering private equity, private debt, infrastructure and real estate solutions.

C:P1.13.text: Responsible investing reflects our belief that financial connectivity and prudent stewardship can help clients achieve their investment goals.

C:P1.14.text: Discover the active, systematic quantitative investment solutions from Federated Hermes MDT Advisers.

C:P1.15.text: Explore our investment solutions designed to help clients meet their investment needs.

C:P1.17.text: Our active ETF lineup offers our most popular strategies in convenient ETF vehicles.

C:P2.2.text: Federated Hermes is a leading global, active asset manager, focused on meeting the diverse and evolving needs of today’s investors. For 70 years, our world-class investment platform has provided active investment expertise across the spectrum, in both public and private markets. Our solutions span equity, fixed income, liquidity, private markets and responsible investments.

C:P2.3.text: Through a relentless commitment to doing business the right way by seeking better outcomes for every client, Federated Hermes has established a position as one of the leaders in the asset management industry. We are differentiated by our deep market experience, independent-thinking investment teams, integrated proprietary research, dynamic data sources and our engagement and stewardship capabilities.

C:P2.4.text: Federated Hermes aims to deliver strong performance consistent with our clients’ needs and expectations by setting a standard for active investment management. Our rigorous approach to vetting investment opportunities, careful attention to prudently allocating risks and dedication to building insightful teams have been key to our investing for decades.

C:P2.5.text: For more than 50 years, Federated Hermes has delivered active fixed-income strategies designed to meet a range of investor needs. Whether the goal is total return, income generation or capital preservation, we have a strategy that’s been vetted to fit the bill.
